items.text: Schwab collaborated with Anthropic and states it is the first RIA custodian included in Claude for Financial Advisors.
items.quote: For our RIA clients, we have collaborated with Anthropic and are proud to be the first RIA custodian included in Claude for Financial Advisors.

items.text: Schwab launched Advisor ProDirect, a membership-based program to help independent RIA firms accelerate sustainable growth and support breakaway advisors on their path to independence.
items.quote: We also launched Advisor ProDirect, which helps breakaway advisors on their path to independence.
